clue.text: A woman of colour

parts.note: reads like a description of ethnicity, but the colour is only that of her hair

explanation.surface: A description of a woman who is not white.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of colour' is the misdirection: the colour meant is dark brown hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman with dark brown hair is called by this name, so her hair supplies the colour.

clue.text: Beat time in a trance

parts.note: to beat is to rap, as on a door

explanation.surface: A musician or hypnotist keeps the beat while someone is entranced.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone completely absorbed or spellbound is as if in a trance.

clue.text: Eat around six? Wonderful!

indicators.note: the word for eating is placed around the numeral, enclosing it

parts.note: to eat a meal is to dine
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone delighted at the prospect of dinner at six o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Divine is used informally as high praise, as in a heavenly or wonderful experience.

clue.text: European travel: journey is a gratifying experience

parts.note: to travel is to go
a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A travel brochure promising that a European journey will be rewarding.
explanation.definitionFit: An ego trip is an activity undertaken mainly for self-satisfaction, an indulgence of one's vanity.

clue.text: Time-saving hairdo?

definitions.meaning: a quicker route that saves time

explanation.surface: Asking about a hairstyle that takes little effort to keep.
explanation.definitionFit: A quicker route saves time, while a cropped hairstyle literally is a short haircut.

clue.text: Astonished to be punched in the face

parts.note: gob is slang for the mouth, so for the face
to be punched is to be smacked

explanation.surface: Someone stunned by being hit in the face.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's punch in the face is literally what the slang word describes.
explanation.definitionFit: Gobsmacked is British slang meaning utterly amazed or flabbergasted.

clue.text: King looking at what typist is doing

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
to eye something is to look at it

explanation.surface: A king watching a secretary at work.
explanation.definitionFit: A typist enters text by pressing keys, which is keying it in.

clue.text: Shattering sort of news

definitions.meaning: ... news is news just coming in

explanation.surface: A dramatic news story described as shattering.
explanation.definitionFit: Glass breaking is shattering, and urgent new reports are labelled breaking news.

clue.text: Siren's nose

definitions.meaning: a siren or horn giving a warning blast

explanation.surface: The nose belonging to a mythical siren.
explanation.definitionFit: A factory or ship's warning horn is a hooter; the same word is jokey slang for a large nose.

clue.text: One takes a little bite, aftertaste coming back

indicators.note: returning signals that the word for the taste is read backwards

parts.note: a tang is a sharp lingering taste

explanation.surface: Someone nibbling food and noticing a flavour that lingers.
explanation.definitionFit: This small insect bites people, leaving an itchy little mark.

clue.text: Impound vessel for unpaid work

parts.note: to intern is to confine or detain
a ship is a vessel

explanation.surface: Authorities seizing a boat to use it for free labour.
explanation.definitionFit: A placement, often unpaid, where a trainee gains work experience.

clue.text: Bread for example not fresh, but quietly accepted

indicators.note: the word for not fresh takes in the musical letter, holding it inside

parts.note: stale means not fresh
P is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: A loaf that is past its best but eaten without complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread is a basic everyday food, a typical example of a dietary mainstay.

clue.text: Pretend to be an impresario

definitions.meaning: an impresario literally puts on acts, staging shows

explanation.surface: Someone faking being a theatre promoter.
explanation.definitionFit: Feigning is putting on an act; a theatrical producer stages performers' acts.

clue.text: Taking the driving seat, change gear after a short distance

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come after the distance word

parts.note: an inch is a short distance

indicators.note: to change something is to alter it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for a driver who has just taken the wheel and moved a little.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driving seat' is idiom here, not literal motoring; the gear change in the surface is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the driving seat is an idiom for being in control, the one running things.

clue.text: Tied house right behind field

indicators.note: the right-winger stands behind, coming after, the field

parts.note: a rec is a recreation ground, a playing field
a Tory is a right-winger, a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A pub owned by a brewery standing just behind a field.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'tied house' usually means a brewery-owned pub; here it is a home tied to a job.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman's residence goes with the post, so it is housing tied to employment.

clue.text: One booked into hotel has seen dirt all over the place

indicators.note: scattered in every direction, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A hotel guest who has noticed mess everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A guest staying at a hotel is described as a resident there.

clue.text: Son enjoying a spliff, adding more to burn

parts.note: toking is slang for drawing on a joint

explanation.surface: A son smoking cannabis and lighting up again.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeding a fire with fuel to keep it burning is stoking it.

clue.text: Refinements that used to go with smart shirts?

definitions.text: that used to go with smart shirts?
definitions.meaning: read as ..., the neckwear once worn with a smart shirt

explanation.surface: Wondering about elegant extras once paired with formal shirts.
explanation.definitionFit: Subtle points of etiquette or detail are refinements, the finer points.

clue.text: From madness, putting out small idiotic remark

indicators.note: expelling, so the size letter is taken away

parts.note: insanity is madness

explanation.surface: A foolish comment that stems from madness.
explanation.definitionFit: An inanity is a silly or empty statement, a piece of foolishness.

clue.text: A boy's boy?

parts.note: the son of someone's son is that person's grandchild

explanation.surface: A puzzling phrase about one lad belonging to another.
explanation.definitionFit: A son's son is the grandparent's male grandchild.

clue.text: Not the ways, we hear, to travel to this island

indicators.note: spoken out loud, so a word that is pronounced the same is needed

parts.note: roads are ways

explanation.surface: You cannot drive to an island; roads are not how you get there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' signals ROADS said out loud; 'Not' adds the joke that roads can't reach an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhodes is a Greek island in the Aegean, largest of the Dodecanese.

clue.text: Roughly remove dressing for bad cut

indicators.note: arranging or setting in order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tearing off a bandage that covers a nasty wound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing' looks like a bandage but signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To kidnap someone is to take them away by force.

clue.text: A writer about myself and distant ancestors

indicators.note: the writing implement goes around, enclosing, the pronoun

parts.note: a pen is something to write with
me stands for myself

explanation.surface: An author writing about themself and their forebears, a family memoir.
explanation.definitionFit: Early hominids are imagined as half-ape, half-human forebears of humans.

clue.text: Moving under, can do circular steps

indicators.note: being shifted about, so the letters change position

explanation.surface: A dancer bragging they can shimmy under a bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A folk dance in which dancers move in a ring, so its steps go round in a circle.

clue.text: Wicket perhaps finally suggesting skulduggery

definitions.meaning: a wicket is a small ..., so an example
added at the end of a word, -... implies a scandal, after Watergate

explanation.surface: A cricket wicket hinting at match-fixing.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the wicket is the stumps, but a wicket is also a small door or gate.
explanation.definitionFit: A wicket gate is a small gate; the suffix from Watergate marks political scandal.

clue.text: Good and bad quantity of drink

parts.note: ill means bad, as in ill effects

explanation.surface: Mixed reviews of a measure of alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: A gill is an old British measure of liquid, a quarter of a pint.
explanation.definitionFit: A gill is a small unit of liquid volume, used for spirits or beer.

clue.text: Senior cleric taking care of a junior one

indicators.note: the senior churchman takes in, holding inside, the postal abbreviation

parts.note: a dean heads a cathedral chapter
c/o is the postal abbreviation for care of

explanation.surface: A senior priest looking after a junior colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: A deacon is an ordained minister ranking below a priest, so a lower-ranking cleric.

clue.text: Music suggested by dejected Royal Navy?

definitions.meaning: blue means dejected, and navy is a blue

explanation.surface: Wondering what music a gloomy navy would play.
explanation.definitionFit: A melancholy music style from African-American tradition, also a word for low spirits.
